name: Vibrant Pop
description: Bold, vibrant photography with saturated colors and high energy
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Only change the background to a vibrant, solid color and adjust lighting to bright, even studio lighting. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only modify the environment (background, lighting) around the unchanged product.

objects.description: The exact product from the input image, preserved as-is, with vibrant color enhancement
objects.relationship: Primary subject with bold color contrast against vibrant background
